text: The text contains a reference to a specific type of malware known as a rootkit. A rootkit is a malicious software tool designed to conceal the existence of certain processes or programs from normal methods of detection and enable continued privileged access to a computer. The text explicitly states that this rootkit has been identified within the operating system level of several financial institutions, where it conceals itself and provides unauthorized access. This indicates a serious security threat involving stealthy, high-level compromise of critical financial infrastructure.
